name: Shidou Eiji
source:
Faceless protagonist of the game.

Eiji is part of the school swimming club and attends a high school on the mainland. He is visiting his home island alongside the other members of the swimming club as part of his summer vacation.

[spoiler]He joins the life guards as a part-timer after his former teacher Youko promises to help him with his summer homework[/spoiler]
